title: flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass advisory. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO full command string. Status is always "ok" — this hook never blocks.

tool.description: Always "Bash" — this advisory matches only Bash tool calls.

subject.description: Privacy-safe command subject `Bash:<first-token>` with leading sudo / env-assignment prefixes stripped and the token basenamed. NEVER the full command or its arguments.

forms.description: Bypass forms flagged (e.g. "gh-pr-create-bypass"). Empty array when nothing was flagged.
